outcome: evolution of physical activity during pregnancy
identification of barriers to physical activity during pregnancy
cohort: 120 women between the ages of 18 and 40 who had a monofetal, spontaneous and physiological pregnancy, resulting in a low birth or caesarean delivery
finding: Physical activity decreases during pregnancy, with fear of the consequences of physical activity on pregnancy and the future child being the main barrier, partly related to the lack of information on the possibilities of sporting activity during pregnancy.
